'''''Convolvulus sabatius''''', the '''ground blue-convolvulus'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> or '''blue rock bindweed''', is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Convolvulaceae]], [[native plant|native]] to Italy and North Africa, and often seen in cultivation.<ref name=GRIN>{{GRIN | accessdate=2009-04-13}}</ref>

==Description== 
It is a woody-stemmed trailing [[perennial plant]], growing to {{convert|20|cm|0|abbr=on}} in height.<ref name=Armitage/> It has slightly hairy leaves and light blue to violet flowers, often with a lighter centre, which is {{convert|2.5|-|5|cm|0|abbr=on}} in diameter.<ref name=Armitage>{{cite book|author=Armitage, Allan M. |author2=Asha Kays, Chris Johnson| title=Armitage's manual of annuals, biennials, and half-hardy perennials |publisher=Timber Press| year=2001 | isbn=0881925055|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=mY0e3D_Z0poC&q=convolvulus+sabatius&pg=PA170 |accessdate=2009-04-13}}</ref> The stem is decumbent to ascending and non-twining. The leaves are all entire. The base of the [[leaf blade]] is slightly heart-shaped and [[truncate]] to wedge-shaped. The [[Petal|corolla]] is 15 to 22 millimeters long and blue to pink.

The Latin [[binomial nomenclature|specific epithet]] ''sabatius'' refers to the [[Savona]] region of Italy.<ref name=RHSLG>{{cite book |last=Harrison |first=Lorraine |title=RHS Latin for Gardeners |year=2012 |publisher=Mitchell Beazley |location=United Kingdom |isbn=978-1845337315 }}</ref>

==Cultivation==
This species is often sold under the [[synonym (taxonomy)|synonym]] ''C. mauritanicus''. Although a perennial, it is best treated as an [[annual plant|annual]] in colder climates.<ref name=Armitage/> It is suited to window boxes and containers and prefers a sunny situation with good drainage. Tip pruning encourages new growth and flowering.<ref name=Armitage/> It has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref name = RHSPF>{{cite web | url = http://apps.rhs.org.uk/plantselector/plant?plantid=524 | title = ''Convolvulus sabatius'' | website = www.rhs.org | publisher = RHS | accessdate = 3 September 2019 | archive-date = 8 April 2014 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20140408215059/http://apps.rhs.org.uk/plantselector/plant?plantid=524 | url-status = dead }}</ref>
